children: SKYX Platforms signed a definitive agreement to acquire Deako, an AI-driven smart home and lighting systems company. The consideration includes 25,000,000 SKYX shares (18.46% of outstanding) subject to staged lock-ups, $4 million in cash, and $8.5 million of senior secured promissory notes bearing 12% interest. The Merger Shares will be held in escrow for Deako’s senior lenders and sold under a Rule 10b5-1 plan, with any residual shares distributed to Deako securityholders. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including Deako securityholder approval, with an outside date of October 31, 2026.
